query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!: i64"
            FROM downloads
            WHERE
                CASE status
                    WHEN 'pending' THEN 0
                    WHEN 'resolving' THEN 0
                    WHEN 'downloading' THEN 0
                    WHEN 'downloaded' THEN 0
                    WHEN 'tagging' THEN 0
                    WHEN 'failed' THEN 1
                    WHEN 'paused' THEN 1
                    ELSE 2
                END = 1
